title: Where and LAN: Run asks one question before it opens a network port
covers: Where row, LAN consent at Run, locked rows while a tab is open, Remote hint
context: Where (Local, LAN, Remote) is separate from Allow direct connections. With LAN, Run asks once before it opens a network port. The rows Where and Allow direct connections are locked while the session has an open lobby tab. This visible launch is a normal user launch, so the question and discovery work.
changed: hooks/useSessionStart: LAN consent before the tab opens, asserted again in main
views/SessionBuilder place rows and their locks

steps: Open Sessions, New session. Name it LAN check, add a player Host1 with A Link to the Past, press Save. In How players join the row Where shows Local (selected), LAN and Remote. LAN is not greyed out although Allow direct connections is off.
Choose LAN and hover it: the hint says the lobby port opens and the session is announced only with direct connections on, and that Run asks once before it opens a network port.
Press Save and run. The question Open this computer to your network? appears. Press Keep it private. Nothing opens and you stay on the setup page.
Press Run and then Open to my network. If Windows shows a firewall alert, allow it for private networks. A tab LAN check opens with Where LAN.
In the Network widget on the left a notice reads This computer is Stop closes The facts show the Lobby address Close the tab, then run the session again: the question does not come back.

Open Sessions and pick LAN check while its tab is open. A note says the session has an open tab. Where and Allow direct connections are locked with the reason Close the lobby of this session first. Close the tab: they can change again.
Turn Allow direct connections on and hover Remote. With no saved Archipelia server it is greyed out and the hint says none is saved yet and to add one on the Servers page.
Press Stop in the Network widget (open the widget from Servers, Archipelia servers, This computer if it is hidden). The notice goes away and Network mode shows Off again.
pass: Where offers Local, LAN and Remote, Local is the default, and LAN works with direct connections off.
Run asks the LAN question once. Keep it private changes nothing, Open to my network opens the tab.
While the tab is open, Where and Allow direct connections are locked. After it closes they can change.
Stop returns the network mode to Off.
fail: The network opens without the question, or the question comes back at every Run after you answered Open to my network.
Where or Allow direct connections can be changed while the tab is open.
A line says This launch is automated. This visible launch must not say it.
After Stop the Network mode still shows LAN only.
notes: The firewall alert depends on Windows. If you allowed this Electron app before, Windows will not ask again. That is not a failure.
Remote is greyed out with direct connections on until an Archipelia server is saved. The test Archipelia servers covers saving one.
The first test of privacy, Privacy: a fresh install does not listen on the network, covers the state before any of this.
